wheelchairRemovableVariantSemantics.evidence: Official plans distinguish wheelchair-on/off floor totals, orchestra-pit unavailable seats, and yellow removable seats, but do not map complete numbered wheelchair replacement, companion, and removable-seat semantics.

firstPass.method: visual review of current issuer seat plan 1
firstPass.result: Full numbered drawing exists, but it cannot be turned into a unique selectable configuration while official wheelchair/removable semantics remain unmapped.

independentSecondPass.method: current issuer seat plan 2 and current facility/seat pages
independentSecondPass.result: Floor totals change with wheelchair use, but no independent numbered replacement or companion mapping is published.

venues.reopenOnlyWhen: The operator publishes complete numbered mappings for wheelchair/companion use and every removable/pit exclusion for one issuer-defined configuration.

wheelchairRemovableVariantSemantics.evidence: The current facility page separately lists four wheelchair spaces. The separate current technical seating plan marks wheelchair, removable, and reclining/backrest symbols but does not supply their seat-number correspondence or companion semantics.

firstPass.method: 300dpi visual review of current official numbered plan
firstPass.result: The plan directly states 1,252 fixed seats (1F 912, 2F 340) and separately marks four wheelchair spaces.

independentSecondPass.method: current official technical seating plan plus barrier-free page
independentSecondPass.result: The technical plan provides wheelchair/removable/backrest symbols without numbered-seat mapping; the barrier-free page confirms four wheelchair spaces but no companion or replacement IDs. A full-ID independent comparison and rangeDiff cannot be established without invention.

venues.reopenOnlyWhen: The operator publishes a current numbered technical plan that maps all wheelchair/removable/backrest positions and companion/replacement treatment, or a second independently published complete numbered plan with zero diff.
